turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Yes! First, watch me do one.
We run in the park. It runs in the park.
The word is "it", so "run" becomes "runs".
Rule: after he, she or it, put -s on the verb.
Right: He opens the door. Wrong: He open the door.

Your turn. Write only the verb:
My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
